reasons: Correctly classified as a deviation: the original 180-day non-renewal notice window far exceeds the preferred 30-day position and the 60-day fallback, approaching the walk-away threshold (>90 days).

Redline reaches the playbook position with a targeted edit: notice window set to 30 days, 12-month renewal term preserved, and a 60-day Vendor renewal reminder added as the preferred position requires.

The elevated changed-character ratio is explained by the added reminder sentence and the clarifying 'before the end of the then-current term' language; no unrelated terms were altered, so the edit remains substantively minimal.

Comment is accurate and appropriately scoped: it states what changed, cites the playbook rationale, and offers the 60-day fallback without lecturing; it correctly refrains from re-negotiating the Section 8.3 uplift cap, which already satisfies the CPI/3% requirement.
